note: Both sets share the same misread of the finished floor elevation as 2' - 3 1/2" where the sheet and text layer both read 2' - 9 1/2", and both repeat several claims. Set A adds unsupported bindings: CENTRE MODULE located at grid 'K' (quote does not support it), Mechanical Room located in 'Building Section A302' (A-302 is the sheet number, not a section), plus vague claims like 'building section contains room' and the tautology 'WEST MODULE location West'. Set B keeps the scale claims correctly tied to details A1 and C1 and the room/adjacency claims are supported by the section drawings, so it is the more faithful set despite considerable duplication.
